answer: Pay each referral bonus only once the invited account has passed answers in 10 different epochs. Someone bringing in a few real friends barely notices. A farm that invites itself in a spiral, each new account inviting the next, gets nothing up front anymore. Every link has to land 10 real passes, say on basalt quarry pricing or a beacon repair job, in 10 separate epochs. That's 2.5 days of real time per link with honest graders judging each one, and shell accounts that can't write passing answers never pay out at all.
